Parent race rules: https://srd.dndtools.org/srd/races/racesCore.html#half-elves

aquatic-half-orc.text:
Swim 30 ft. Emissaries: Diplomacy and Gather Information +2.

Retained half orc traits: Counts as an orc for race-related effects. Starting Intelligence after racial adjustment is at least 3.

Aquatic subtype: breathe water, not air unless another ability grants amphibious breathing. Outside water, hold breath for twice Constitution score rounds before suffocation checks. Swim +8; always take 10, and run while swimming straight. Aquan is a bonus language. Unearthed Arcana suggests optional LA +1 for mixed aquatic/non-aquatic underwater or ship campaigns.

arctic-half-orc.text:
Low-light vision replaces darkvision; Diplomacy +2.

Retained half orc traits: Counts as an orc for race-related effects. Starting Intelligence after racial adjustment is at least 3.

desert-half-orc.text:
Low-light vision replaces darkvision; Run bonus feat.

Retained half orc traits: Counts as an orc for race-related effects. Starting Intelligence after racial adjustment is at least 3.

frostblood-half-orc.text:
Dragonblood subtype; cold resistance 10; vulnerability to fire. Endurance bonus feat; if a later source would grant Endurance again, choose another qualifying feat.

Retained half orc traits: Counts as an orc for race-related effects. Starting Intelligence after racial adjustment is at least 3.

jungle-half-orc.text:
Low-light vision replaces darkvision; Climb and Jump +2.

Retained half orc traits: Counts as an orc for race-related effects. Starting Intelligence after racial adjustment is at least 3.

scabland-half-orc.text:
Low-light vision replaces darkvision. Can go 48 + Constitution score hours without water before thirst effects. Heat Endurance bonus feat.

Retained half orc traits: Counts as an orc for race-related effects. Starting Intelligence after racial adjustment is at least 3.

aquatic-halfling.text:
Swim 20 ft. Low-light vision sees four times ordinary human distance in dim light, retaining color/detail.

Retained halfling traits: All saves +1. Fear saves gain an additional +2 morale bonus. Thrown-weapon attacks +1. Sling attacks +1.

Aquatic subtype: breathe water, not air unless another ability grants amphibious breathing. Outside water, hold breath for twice Constitution score rounds before suffocation checks. Swim +8; always take 10, and run while swimming straight. Aquan is a bonus language. Unearthed Arcana suggests optional LA +1 for mixed aquatic/non-aquatic underwater or ship campaigns.

athasian-halfling.text:
Inborn Power: 3 PP and missive, adding to class pools/known powers; ML equals character level; Charisma DCs or your psionic class’s manifesting ability.

Climb, Jump and Move Silently bonuses: +2 initially, +4 at level 5, +8 at level 15. At level 10, standing long jumps count as running and accelerated climbing loses its −5 penalty.

Retained halfling traits: All saves +1. Fear saves gain an additional +2 morale bonus. Thrown-weapon attacks +1. Sling attacks +1.

deep-halfling.text:
Darkvision 60 ft. Stonecunning: Search +2 for stonework, automatic check within 10 ft., rogue-style stone-trap detection and intuitive depth. Stone/metal Appraise/Craft +2. Lose Climb, Jump and Move Silently racial bonuses.

Retained halfling traits: All saves +1. Fear saves gain an additional +2 morale bonus. Thrown-weapon attacks +1. Sling attacks +1.

d-hin.text:
Counts as halfling; darkvision 60 ft.; all saves +1; thrown/sling attacks +2. Air Mastery: airborne attackers take −1 attack/damage against you.

Prestidigitation at will; one daily choice of gust of wind, whispering wind or wind wall. CL equals character level; Charisma DCs.

ghostwise-halfling.text:
Speak without Sound: telepathy to one creature at a time within 20 ft., requiring a shared language. Lose halfling +1 all-saves bonus.

Retained halfling traits: Fear saves gain an additional +2 morale bonus. Thrown-weapon attacks +1. Sling attacks +1.

glimmerskin-halfling.text:
Dragonblood subtype; Heal always a class skill; lose Move Silently racial bonus.

Touch of Luck 1/day: immediate action before a save, grant self or ally within 30 ft. +2 luck on that save.

Retained halfling traits: All saves +1. Fear saves gain an additional +2 morale bonus. Thrown-weapon attacks +1. Sling attacks +1.

jungle-halfling.text:
Proficient with throwing axe, handaxe and shortbow (including composite). Poison Use prevents self-poisoning during application or combat. Poison Fortitude saves +2. Lose halfling general-save, fear-save and sling-attack bonuses.

Retained halfling traits: Thrown-weapon attacks +1.

shoal-halfling.text:
Humanoid (aquatic, halfling); breathes air/water. Swim 20 ft.; Swim +8; take 10 under threat and run while swimming straight. Lose thrown/sling attack bonuses and racial Climb/Jump/Move Silently bonuses.

Retained halfling traits: All saves +1. Fear saves gain an additional +2 morale bonus.

unsheltered-halfling.text:
Lose halfling general-save and fear-save bonuses. Gain Dodge at level 1; at level 3 choose bonus Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes or Great Fortitude.

Retained halfling traits: Thrown-weapon attacks +1. Sling attacks +1.

harssaf.text:
Natural armor +3; blindsense 30 ft.; DR 5/bludgeoning; fast healing 3; SR 17 + class levels. Immune to blindness/fire, vulnerable to cold.

Flaming Aura: free action at will; 1d6 fire/round within 5 ft., plus 1d6 on melee hits (only metal weapons conduct it).

Sand Pulse 1/day, standard action: 30-ft. radius, 3d6 damage and blindness 5 rounds; Reflex DC 15 halves and prevents blindness. Eyeless creatures avoid blindness; harssafs are immune.

Sand Form at will, standard action: gaseous form as mobile sand, no flight; can pass gaps narrower than ¼ inch.

hengeyokai.text:
Humanoid (shapechanger). Human form: Medium, speed 30 ft. Choose an animal kind: badger, carp, cat, crab, crane, dog, fox, hare, monkey, raccoon dog, rat, sparrow or weasel.

Alternate Form: human, hybrid or chosen animal; full-round action provoking opportunity attacks; daily changes 1 + character level. Animal form melds equipment and disables magic items, grants low-light vision, communication with its animal kind and Disguise +10; use that animal’s form statistics. Hybrid retains low-light vision/animal communication, uses its hybrid adjustments and unmelded equipment; light/medium armor fits, heavy armor cannot be worn.

Hybrid choices (apply only your chosen kind): badger Constitution +2, land 20/burrow 10 ft.; carp Dexterity +2, land 10/swim 30 ft.; cat Dexterity +2, Balance +4; crab natural armor +1 and Swim +4; crane or sparrow Dexterity +2, land 20/fly 20 ft. (average); dog Constitution +2, scent-tracking Survival +4; fox Dexterity +2, Escape Artist +4; hare Dexterity +2, land 40 ft.; monkey Dexterity +2, Climb +4; raccoon dog Strength +2, scent-tracking Survival +4; rat Dexterity +2, Hide +4; weasel Constitution +2, Move Silently +4.

Animal forms below give size; movement in ft.; AC; attacks; Strength/Dexterity/Constitution. They replace physical form statistics, not mental abilities.

Badger: Tiny; land 30/burrow 10; AC 15; two claws 1d2−1 and bite 1d3−1; 8/17/15. Carp: Diminutive; swim 10; AC 19; no attack; 1/20/10. Cat: Tiny; land 30; AC 14; two claws 1d2−4 and bite 1d3−4; 3/15/10.

Crab: Diminutive; land 15; AC 18; two claws 1d2−5; 1/17/10. Crane: Small; land 5/fly 60 (average); AC 14; bite 1d4−2; 6/16/10. Dog: Small; land 40; AC 15; bite 1d4+1; 13/17/15.

Fox: Small; land 40; AC 15; bite 1d4; 11/19/11. Hare: Tiny; land 40; AC 16; bite 1d3−5; 1/19/10. Monkey: Tiny; land 30/climb 30; AC 14; bite 1d3−4; 3/15/10.

Raccoon dog: Small; land 30; AC 13; bite 1d4+1; 12/13/12. Rat: Tiny; land 15/climb 15; AC 14; bite 1d3−4; 2/15/10. Sparrow: Fine; land 1/fly 50 (average); AC 24; no attack; 1/23/10. Weasel: Tiny; land 20/climb 20; AC 14; bite 1d3−4; 3/15/10.

insectare.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +2; Bluff/Disguise +2; counts as elf.

Antenna Rake: two off-hand attacks with normal off-hand penalties, each 1d4 slashing + half Strength; alternatively one antenna as a normal attack action.

kender.text: All saves +1; Spot +2; Open Lock/Sleight of Hand +2 and usable untrained. Concentration −4. Taunt grants Bluff +4 when provoking a target. Immune to all fear.

kenku.text:
Great Ally (Ex): successful aid another on a skill check or attack grants +3 rather than +2 when the kenku aids or receives aid. Flanking attacks gain +4 rather than +2. These replace the ordinary bonuses; do not add both.

Mimicry (Ex): reproduce familiar sounds, voices and accents. This grants no new languages. Impersonating a particular voice uses Bluff opposed by a familiar listener’s Sense Motive.

Natural weapons: two claws, 1d3 damage each for a Medium kenku.

Racial skills: +2 Hide and Move Silently. Low-light vision. Common and Kenku; bonus languages Auran, Dwarven, Gnome, Goblin and Halfling. Favored class: rogue. Monster Manual III.

khepri.text: Darkvision 60 ft.; enchantment (mind-affecting) saves +2; gaze saves +4; Intimidate/Spot +2.

kir-lanan.text:
Land 30 ft., fly 90 ft. (good); darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +3; Hide +4; simple weapons/light armor proficiency. Four racial monstrous-humanoid HD grant BAB +4, saves +1/+4/+4, two feats and 7 × (2 + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1) skill points; no extra first-class ×4 multiplier.

Two claws 1d4, or one secondary claw at −5 and half Strength with a one-handed weapon. Negative Energy Touch 3/day: melee touch or successful claw hit adds 2d6 damage and 1 Strength damage (Fortitude DC 12 + Charisma modifier negates Strength); heal the energy damage dealt, not claw damage.

Ray of enfeeblement 3/day, CL 4; rebuke/command undead 3/day as evil cleric of HD. Positive energy harms and negative energy heals, but cannot be turned.

Soulless: no divine casting or positive-energy use; no cleric, druid or paladin; ranger never gains spells. Bard may replace cure with inflict. Revival requires wish or miracle.

desert-kobold.text: Lose light sensitivity and Profession (miner) racial bonus; Survival +2.

jungle-kobold.text:
Permanently acclimated to high altitude, immune to altitude sickness. Climb +2 and uses Dexterity instead of Strength. Lose Craft (trapmaking) and Profession (miner) racial bonuses.

Retained kobold traits: Bright sunlight or daylight causes dazzled status.

korobokuru.text: Darkvision 60 ft.; poison and magic saves +2; attacks against goblinoids +1; giant dodge AC +4 (lost without Dexterity to AC); Survival +2.

kuo-toa.text:
Amphibious; electricity resistance 10; poison/paralysis/web immunity; natural armor +6. Escape Artist +8; Search/Spot +4; pincer staff counts as martial. Moving invisible/ethereal creatures are visible to Keen Sight. Sudden bright light blinds 1 round; −1 attacks/saves/checks while exposed.

Lightning Bolt: at least two cleric whips join hands to fire, staying within 30 ft. during its 1d4-round buildup. Damage 1d6 per whip; Reflex DC 11 + highest Wisdom modifier + whip count halves.

Adhesive shield: 1 hour and 20 gp preparation, lasts 3 days or one catch. A missed melee attacker saves Reflex DC 11 + your Constitution modifier or its weapon sticks (natural weapon starts a grapple). Strength DC 20 frees it.

kyrie.text: Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +2. Racial spellcasting and one domain as a level-3 mystic.

blackscale-lizardfolk.text: Space/reach 10/10 ft.; darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +7; acid resistance 5. Proficient with greatclub, javelin and simple weapons. Two claws and bite each 1d6. Hold breath for 4 × Constitution score rounds.

poison-dusk-lizardfolk.text:
Low-light vision; natural armor +3; two claws and bite each 1d3. Bolas/nets count as martial. Safely apply poison.

Chameleon Skin grants Hide +5 only without covering clothes, robes or armor. Hold breath for 4 × Constitution score rounds.

viletooth-lizardfolk.text:
Dragonblood subtype. Acid Bite adds 1d6 acid to bite damage. Water Breathing is unlimited, replacing extended Hold Breath. Move Silently always a class skill.

Retained lizardfolk traits: Two claws and one bite, 1d4 damage each.

loxo.text:
Monstrous humanoid; space/reach 10/10 ft.; darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +4; simple weapons/light armor proficiency. One trunk slam 1d6, two with a full attack; a weapon full attack can add one secondary trunk at −5.

Seeing a clan member killed/incapacitated triggers Berserk Rage: Strength/Constitution +4, Will +2 morale, AC −2 for 3 + improved Constitution modifier rounds. Afterwards fatigued until encounter ends (source lists Strength/Constitution −2 and no running/charging).

Standard-action Trample over Medium or smaller foes: 1d8 + 1½ Strength; targets choose an opportunity attack at −4 or Reflex DC 12 + Strength modifier for half.

lumi.text:
Darkvision 60 ft. CL 3: disrupt undead/light at will; cure light wounds/glitterdust 3/day.

Body of Light: immune to death, energy drain and negative energy; gain positive-plane fast healing without explosive temporary HP. Permanent 5-ft. glow, concealable with magical darkness.

Clear Vision: immune to blindness/dazzling and direct light attacks, including color spray, rainbow pattern, searing light, sunbeam/sunburst; sun blades cause nonlethal damage. Fog/darkness still conceal.

Floating Head: flankers receive no +2 attack bonus; immune to vorpal decapitation, strangulation and suffocation.

lupin.text:
Monstrous humanoid; darkvision 60 ft.; Listen +2; Ride +2 and always a class skill; attacks/damage against werewolves +1.

Acute Smell: Wisdom DC 10 detects lycanthropes within 30 ft. (double upwind, half downwind). Within 5 ft., Spot +5 against familiar individuals’ disguises and a free Wisdom DC 10 check pinpoints hidden/invisible creatures. Survival tracking +2, but no scent-only tracking. Odor-based saves −2.

mind-flayer.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +3; four tentacles 1d4; SR 25 + class levels; telepathy 100 ft.

Mind Blast: 60-ft. cone stuns 3d4 rounds; Charisma-based Will negates, equivalent to level-4 spell. At will, CL 8 and Charisma DCs: charm monster, detect thoughts, levitate, plane shift, suggestion.

Improved Grab: tentacle hit on Small–Large foe permits free grapple without provoking; larger targets require reaching the head. Starting a turn with a tentacle attached permits one grapple check to attach all others. Victim escapes with grapple/Escape Artist, opposed with +2 per attached tentacle.

Extract: begin turn with all four attached and win a grapple check to kill by brain extraction; ineffective on constructs, elementals, oozes, plants or undead, and not instantly lethal to multiple-headed foes.

minotaur.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; scent; natural armor +5. Space and reach 10 ft. Proficient with simple weapons and the greataxe.

Gore: 1d8 damage. A charge uses a powerful gore for 4d6 + 1½ Strength modifier damage.

Natural Cunning: immune to maze; never becomes lost; can track enemies; never caught flat-footed.

krynnish-minotaur.text:
Natural armor +2; +2 racial bonus on Intimidate, Swim, and Use Rope.

Gore: 1d6 + Strength modifier, or 2d6 + 1½ Strength modifier when charging. Alongside a manufactured weapon, gore is secondary at −5 and adds half Strength.

May select Scent as a feat; scent is not automatically granted.

thoradorian-minotaur.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +5; space and reach 10 ft. Proficient with simple weapons and one selected martial weapon, usually a greataxe. Search, Spot, and Listen gain +4 racial bonuses.

Gore: 1d8 + Strength modifier; charging deals 4d6 + 1½ Strength modifier. As a secondary attack alongside a weapon, gore takes −5 and adds half Strength.

Natural Cunning: immune to maze; never becomes lost; can track enemies; never caught flat-footed. Scent may be selected as a feat, but is not automatic.

rilkan.text:
Humanoid (reptilian). All Knowledge skills can be used as trained, including with no ranks. Knowledge checks and bardic knowledge gain a +1 competence bonus, increased by +1 per two soulmelds currently shaped.

Bluff and Diplomacy gain +2 racial bonuses. A successful aid another action from another rilkan grants +3 instead of +2.

skarn.text:
Humanoid (reptilian); +2 racial bonus on Climb and Intimidate.

Arm Spines: one spine attack per round deals 1d6 piercing damage. It may be primary or an off-hand attack with normal off-hand penalties and half Strength damage. An arm cannot both wield a weapon and attack with spines in the same round. Using the shield arm loses its shield AC bonus until the next turn.

A soulmeld bound to the arms chakra makes spine attacks lawful for overcoming damage reduction.

exiled-modron.text:
Living construct. Natural armor +2; acid, cold, and fire resistance 2; +2 on saves against illusions and mind-affecting effects; +2 racial bonus on Listen and Spot.

In combat it did not initiate, an exiled modron remains flat-footed until its second turn, even though it can act on its first.

Charisma-based skills take −2 against chaotic creatures. Armor and clothing must be made for its unusual body.

Living Construct: has Constitution and is subject to mind-affecting effects, critical hits, nonlethal damage, stunning, ability damage/drain, death effects, and necromancy. Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, sickening, and energy drain. No eating, breathing, or sleeping; spell preparation still requires rest. Lethal damage does not heal naturally. Healing-subschool spells and supernatural HP/ability healing have half effect; repair magic works normally. Can be raised or resurrected. At 0 HP, disabled without losing HP from exertion; from −1 to −9, inert but stable. Heat/chill metal and repel metal/stone treat the body as metal armor; repel wood also works. Rusting grasp deals 2d6, Reflex DC 14 + caster ability modifier halves; rust-monster touch uses Reflex DC 17. Object-only stone/wood shaping spells do not affect it.

neraphim.text:
Outsider from Limbo; extraplanar on other planes. Humanoid-only spells do not affect it. Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +2; +5 racial bonus on Jump and +2 on Search and Spot. Treat the annulat as a martial weapon.

Camouflage: when charging or making a thrown-weapon attack, deny the target its Dexterity bonus to AC for that attack. This can enable sneak attack and other consequences of losing Dexterity to AC. Usable once against each enemy per encounter.

nezumi.text:
Low-light vision; scent; +2 racial bonus on Hide and Move Silently and on saves against poison and disease.

Claws or Bite: one unarmed natural attack per round deals 1d4 lethal damage.

Shadowlands Taint: does not acquire Taint from exposure. This immunity does not prevent damage from Taint-related spells or monsters.

nycter.text:
Darkvision and blindsense 60 ft.; natural armor +3. Blindsense locates creatures but does not remove concealment. Vulnerable to sonic damage.

Hunting Cry: a 30-ft. cone deals 2d4 sonic damage and paralyzes for 1d4 + 1 rounds. A Constitution-based Fortitude save halves damage and prevents paralysis. This sonic, mind-affecting ability recharges after 2d4 rounds; a successful save grants immunity to that nycter’s cry for 24 hours.

ogre.text: Darkvision 60 ft.; low-light vision; natural armor +5. Space and reach 10 ft. Proficient with simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields.

eneko.text:
Giant; darkvision 60 ft.; low-light vision; +2 racial bonus on saves against poison. Longbow proficiency is a bonus feat.

Powerful Build: count as one size larger for opposed size checks and size-based special attacks when beneficial, and may wield weapons one size larger without penalty. Actual space and reach remain unchanged; this stacks with effects that actually change size.

Spell-like abilities: endure elements and pass without trace once each per day. Caster level is half Hit Dice, minimum 1; save DCs use Charisma.

irda.text:
Humanoid (shapechanger); low-light vision.

Change Shape: three times daily, assume a Small, Medium, or Large humanoid form indefinitely. Gain that form’s natural attacks, natural armor, movement, and extraordinary special attacks, but not its special qualities. Gear stays unchanged; retain own ability scores, hit points, saves, spellcasting, and other special abilities except breath weapons and gaze attacks. Speech is required for verbal spells, and humanlike hands for somatic spells. Gain +10 on Disguise to impersonate that form. Returning to the natural form does not spend a use; death restores it.

Spell-like abilities: dancing lights, detect magic, flare, ghost sound, light, and mage hand once each daily. Caster level equals character level; the source gives save DC 10 + Charisma modifier.

ogre-mage.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; low-light vision; natural armor +5; space and reach 10 ft. Spell resistance 19 + class levels.

Change Shape: assume a Small, Medium, or Large humanoid or giant form.

Spell-like abilities at caster level 9, Charisma-based DCs: darkness and invisibility at will; charm person, cone of cold, gaseous form, and sleep once each daily. In gaseous form, use the normal flying speed with perfect maneuverability; starting or stopping flight is a free action.

Regeneration 5: fire and acid deal normal damage. Severed parts can be reattached by holding them in place for 1 minute, but cannot be regrown. A missing vital organ must be reattached within 10 minutes or the ogre mage dies.

skullcrusher-ogre.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; low-light vision; natural armor +2; space and reach 10 ft. Proficient with simple and martial weapons, all armor, and shields.

Rock Throwing: +1 racial bonus on attacks with rocks weighing 40–50 lb.; range increment 100 ft., maximum five increments.

arctic-orc.text: Low-light vision replaces the standard orc’s darkvision. No light sensitivity. Gain +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal; other inherited orc traits apply unless replaced.

deep-orc.text:
Darkvision 120 ft.; natural armor +2; fire and cold resistance 5. Proficient with greatswords and throwing axes; +2 racial bonus on Craft (armorsmithing) and Craft (weaponsmithing). Counts as an orc for race-related effects.

Light Blindness: sudden bright light blinds for 1 round. While in bright light, take −1 on attacks, saves, and checks.

desert-orc.text:
Low-light vision replaces standard orc darkvision. Endurance is a bonus feat; other inherited orc traits apply unless replaced.

Retained orc traits: Bright sunlight or daylight causes dazzled status.

gray-orc.text: Proficient with the greataxe and longbow; scent. Attacks take −1 in bright sunlight. Counts as an orc for race-related effects.

jungle-orc.text:
Low-light vision replaces standard orc darkvision. Gain +2 racial bonuses on Heal and Survival; other inherited orc traits apply unless replaced.

Retained orc traits: Bright sunlight or daylight causes dazzled status.

mountain-orc.text: Darkvision 60 ft.; proficiency with greataxes and javelins. Attacks take −1 in bright sunlight. Counts as an orc for race-related effects.

scro.text: Darkvision 60 ft.; counts as an orc for race-related effects. Gain +1 racial bonus on attacks against elves, including drow.

tanarukk.text:
Native outsider; darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +4; fire resistance 10; spell resistance 14 + class levels. Proficient with martial weapons; counts as an orc for race-related effects.

Bite: 1d6 damage. When used alongside a manufactured weapon it is secondary at −5 and adds half Strength damage.

Control Flame: once daily at caster level 5, affect nonmagical fire within 10 ft. for 5 minutes. Brighten coals to daylight brightness or double an existing flame’s illumination without changing heat or fuel use.

Five racial outsider Hit Dice grant base attack +5, base saves +4/+4/+4, two feats, and 8 × (8 + Intelligence modifier) skill points. Racial class skills are Hide, Intimidate, Listen, Search, and Spot. The first class level does not multiply skill points by four.

phanaton.text:
Low-light vision; bite deals 1d4 damage. Gain +1 racial bonus on all saves while in a forest. Move Silently gains +4, increasing to +8 in forests; Climb, Jump, Listen, and Spot gain +2.

Glide: speed 20 ft., average maneuverability, traveling 4 ft. horizontally per 1 ft. descended. Cannot hover or glide with a medium or heavy load, while helpless, or while unconscious.

athasian-pterran.text:
Reptilian subtype; natural armor +5; +4 racial bonus on Balance and Jump. Two talons deal 1d4 each; a talon holding a weapon cannot also make its natural attack. Secondary bite deals 1d3.

Inborn Power: gain 3 power points at first level and burst as a known power; manifester level equals character level. Use Charisma for DCs, or choose the relevant ability of a psionic class. These points join any class power-point pool.

quaraphon.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +7; space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. Bite and two hooves each deal 1d6.

Deafening Bellow: once daily, all creatures within 60 ft. take 2d6 sonic damage and make a Constitution-based Fortitude save or become deaf for 1d6 rounds.

rakshasa.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +9; bite 1d6 and two claws 1d4 each. Damage reduction 15/good and piercing; spell resistance 27 + class levels.

Detect Thoughts: continuous, caster level 18, Will DC 13 + Charisma modifier; suppress or resume as a free action.

Spellcasting: as a 7th-level sorcerer. Sorcerer class levels stack for spells known, spells per day, caster-level effects, and familiar abilities.

Change Shape: a standard action assumes any humanoid form or restores the natural form. Humanoid form loses bite and claws. Duration is unlimited, cannot be dispelled, and ends on death; true seeing reveals the natural form.

naztharune-rakshasa.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +5; two claws, 1d4 each. Damage reduction 15/good and piercing; spell resistance 21 + class levels.

Detect Thoughts: continuous at caster level 18, Will DC 15 + Charisma modifier; suppress or resume as a free action.

Sneak Attack: use rogue progression with Hit Dice as rogue level. Applies when flanking or the target is denied Dexterity to AC; extra dice are not multiplied on critical hits.

Change Shape: standard action to assume any humanoid form or return. Lose claws in humanoid form; unlimited duration, not dispellable, ends on death, and true seeing reveals the natural form.

Improved Evasion: no damage on a successful Reflex save for half damage, half on failure. Uncanny Dodge retains Dexterity to AC while flat-footed; Improved Uncanny Dodge prevents flanking except by a rogue of level 15 or higher.

Hide in Plain Sight: may Hide while observed if within 10 ft. of a shadow other than its own. Shadow Jump: dimension door between shadows, totaling 20 ft. daily in one 20-ft. jump or two 10-ft. jumps.

raptoran.text:
Low-light vision; +10 racial bonus on Jump, +2 on Climb and Spot. Treat the footbow as martial. Air-descriptor spells gain +1 caster level. Always know north on the Material Plane.

Glide: speed 40 ft., average maneuverability, 20 ft. forward per 5 ft. descent; no falling damage, hovering, or medium/heavy load. If unconscious or helpless in midair, descending wings limit falling damage to 1d6.

Flight: from 5 Hit Dice, speed 40 ft., average maneuverability. No flight with medium/heavy load, fatigue, or exhaustion. Fly for Constitution modifier rounds (minimum 1) safely, or twice that with fatigue afterward. More than 10 total minutes of flight daily also causes fatigue; gliding between flight rounds is allowed. From 10 Hit Dice, flying requires only normal walking/running exertion.

While able to fly, run in a straight line or dive with a piercing weapon: charge at least 30 ft., descend at least 10 ft., and deal double damage on a hit.

bladeback.text:
Natural armor +4. Two claws deal 1d4 + Strength each; tail deals 1d3 + half Strength bonus (or full Strength penalty).

Cold Torpor: −5 on Fortitude saves against environmental cold; failed saves deal twice the usual nonlethal damage. Gain +4 circumstance bonus on saves against sonic effects, but −4 against gas-based attacks and effects. Scent.

finhead.text:
Natural armor +4. Two claws deal 1d4 + Strength each; tail deals 1d3 + half Strength bonus (or full Strength penalty).

Cold Torpor: −5 on Fortitude saves against environmental cold; failed saves deal twice the usual nonlethal damage. Gain +4 circumstance bonus on saves against sonic effects, but −4 against gas-based attacks and effects. Scent.

flyer.text:
Fly speed 50 ft., average maneuverability; natural armor +4. Two claws deal 1d3 + Strength each; tail deals 1d2 + half Strength bonus (or full Strength penalty).

Cold Torpor: −5 on Fortitude saves against environmental cold; failed saves deal twice the usual nonlethal damage. Gain +4 circumstance bonus on saves against sonic effects, but −4 against gas-based attacks and effects. Scent.

hornhead.text:
Natural armor +5. Two claws deal 1d4 + Strength each; tail deals 1d3 + half Strength bonus (or full Strength penalty) and has 10-ft. reach.

Cold Torpor: −5 on Fortitude saves against environmental cold; failed saves deal twice the usual nonlethal damage. Gain +4 circumstance bonus on saves against sonic effects, but −4 against gas-based attacks and effects. Scent.

slyth.text:
Water breathing; immunity to poison and polymorphing; sonic resistance 5; +4 racial bonus on Disguise, Escape Artist, and Survival. Treat flutter blades as martial weapons.

Alternate Form: standard action to become amorphous for up to 10 minutes per class level. Gear merges and magic items stop functioning. Lose physical armor and natural armor, but retain Dexterity, deflection, and force armor bonuses. Immune to critical hits, flanking, and stunning; fit through 2-inch openings. Cannot attack or cast spells requiring verbal, somatic, material, or focus components; lose other supernatural abilities. Appropriate metamagic can remove spell components. Returning takes a full-round action without provoking; wait as long as the time spent transformed before using this ability again.

spellscale.text:
Humanoid (dragonblood); counts as a dragon for race-related effects. Low-light vision.

Blood Quickening: meditate for 1 hour and choose one benefit for the next 24 hours. No second meditation benefit until the next day. Listed skill bonuses are racial and equal half character level. Temporary feats cannot satisfy prerequisites.

Aasterinian: Disguise bonus and Improved Counterspell three times. Astilabor: Appraise bonus and Eschew Materials throughout the day. Chronepsis: Listen bonus and Silent Spell. Lendys: Concentration bonus and Still Spell.

Bahamut: three times, when casting a spell, select one target or creature in its area; if evil, it takes an extra 2d6 damage. Tiamat: the same option against good creatures instead.

Falazure: inflict spells count as on your list for scrolls and spell-trigger items. Tamara: the same for cure spells. Garyx: Widen Spell twice. Hlal: Perform (storytelling) bonus and Heighten Spell three times. Io: Spellcraft bonus and Empower Spell three times.

spiker.text:
Humanoid native to Acheron, with the extraplanar subtype elsewhere. Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +1; damage reduction 2/piercing or slashing; acid resistance 5. The hide is not metal and has no special vulnerability to rust.

Natural Spikes: attack or deal extra piercing damage in a grapple as with armor spikes; armor-spike proficiency is a bonus feat. Worn armor has its maximum Dexterity bonus reduced by 1 and armor check penalty worsened by 2. Shields and arcane spell failure are unaffected.

bamboo-spirit-folk.text:
Humanoid (spirit); affected by both humanoid-targeting and spirit-targeting magic. Low-light vision; +2 racial bonus on Survival and +4 on Hide in woods or forest.

Trackless Step: leaves no trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked.

Gain +2 racial bonus on saves against effects with earth, rock, stone, or wood in their name, shugenja earth spells, and wu jen earth or wood spells.

Speak with Animals: once daily for 1 minute at caster level 1. The river and sea abilities printed in the same source section belong to those separate variants.

mountain-spirit-folk.text:
Low-light vision; +2 racial bonus on Balance, Jump, and Tumble.

Climb speed 30 ft.; +8 racial bonus on Climb, may always take 10, and retain Dexterity to AC while climbing. Climb checks are still required for DCs above 0. An accelerated climb doubles speed at −5 on the check; cannot run while climbing.

Speak with Animals: once daily, birds only, for 1 minute at caster level 1. River spirit folk abilities in the same source section are a separate variant.

stonechildren.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +4; immunity to acid and poison. Proficient with simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields except tower shields.

Magic Stone: three times daily at caster level 3.

synad.text:
Aberration; humanoid-only effects do not apply. Darkvision 60 ft.; 3 bonus power points at first level, which alone grant no powers.

Threefold Mind: +2 on Will saves. Oracle: once daily, add a +2 insight bonus to initiative, an attack, or a save. An attack or save can receive the bonus after learning the unmodified result failed.

Collective: spend 1 power point as a free action for +2 on a Knowledge or Psicraft check.

Multitask: once daily, spend 1 power point to gain a swift action usable for a purely mental action. It can manifest a power only if the round’s normal actions do not also manifest a power.

taer.text:
Giant; darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +2. Immune to cold; fire damage increases by 50%, regardless of save outcome. Treat greatclubs and longspears as simple weapons.

Natural attacks: two slams at normal attack bonus, 1d3 each; secondary bite at −5, 1d4.

Climb speed 30 ft.; +8 racial bonus on Climb and may always take 10. Retain Dexterity to AC while climbing. Check DCs above 0; accelerated climbing doubles speed at −5; cannot run while climbing.

tasloi.text:
Low-light vision. Bright sunlight or daylight spells cause dazzled status.

Hide and Move Silently gain +4 racial bonuses; Hide increases to +8 in thick forest. Climb uses Dexterity, gains +8 racial bonus, and may always take 10, even when rushed or threatened.

thanoi.text:
Monstrous humanoid (cold); darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +4. Immune to cold and vulnerable to fire. Gain +8 racial bonus on Swim and Balance on ice.

Tusks: primary natural attack deals 2d4 + Strength; may instead accompany a manufactured weapon as a secondary attack at −5.

Great Breath: hold breath underwater for 30 minutes before needing Constitution checks.

thri-kreen.text:
Monstrous humanoid; darkvision 60 ft.; magic sleep immunity; natural armor +3. +30 racial bonus on Jump and +4 on Hide in sandy or arid terrain. Treat gythkas and chatkchas as martial weapons.

Four Arms: eligible for Multiweapon Fighting instead of Two-Weapon Fighting, and for Multiattack; neither is a bonus feat. Four claws deal 1d4 each, with a secondary 1d4 bite. Weapon attacks may be combined with a secondary bite or unused claw at −5.

Poison: one poisonous bite daily; Fortitude DC 11 + Constitution modifier. Initial damage 1d6 Dexterity; secondary effect paralysis.

Gain 1 bonus power point at first level; this alone grants no manifesting ability. Psi-like abilities: chameleon and know direction and location three times daily; greater concealing amorpha and metaphysical claw once daily. Manifester level half Hit Dice, minimum 1; Charisma-based DCs.

tibbit.text:
Monstrous humanoid (shapechanger); darkvision 60 ft.; +2 racial bonus on Spot, Jump, and Escape Artist.

Feline Transformation: standard action to become a Tiny house cat; returning takes a full-round action, followed by a 1-hour wait before transforming again. Cat form grants size bonuses +2 AC/attacks and +8 Hide, +10 ft. land speed, −8 Strength (minimum 3), +2 Dexterity, and scent. Full attack: two 1d2 claws at full bonus and one 1d3 bite at −5; no iterative attacks from high base attack. Other statistics remain unchanged.

Cat-form gear: weapons, armor, shields, and robes merge and cease granting benefits; suitable items such as rings or boots reshape and keep their benefits. Cannot speak, manipulate fine objects, cast verbal/somatic spells, use scrolls, or activate magic items. Death restores humanoid form after 1 round. Magic that penetrates polymorph reveals the disguise; merely detecting magic does not.

t-kel.text: Monstrous humanoid; unaffected by humanoid-only effects. Darkvision 60 ft.; two claws each deal 1d4 + Strength modifier.

troglodyte.text:
Darkvision 90 ft.; natural armor +6; two claws and one bite each deal 1d4.

Stench: when angry or frightened, living creatures other than troglodytes within 30 ft. must make a Constitution-based Fortitude save or be sickened for 10 rounds. The source’s standard creature has DC 13. A successful save grants 24-hour immunity to that troglodyte. Poison immunity prevents the effect and poison-save bonuses apply; delay poison or neutralize poison removes it.

troll.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; low-light vision; scent; natural armor +5; space and reach 10 ft. Two claws and one bite each deal 1d6.

Rend: hitting with both claws adds 2d6 + 1½ Strength modifier damage automatically.

Regeneration 5: fire and acid deal normal damage. Severed parts regrow in 3d6 minutes or can be reattached instantly by holding them against the stump.

crystalline-troll.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; low-light vision; scent; natural armor +7; space and reach 10 ft. Two claws and one bite each deal 1d6. Acid immunity and sonic vulnerability.

Rend: hitting with both claws adds 2d6 + 1½ Strength modifier damage automatically.

Regeneration 5: sonic attacks deal normal damage. Severed parts regrow in 3d6 minutes or reattach instantly when held against the stump.

unbodied.text:
Fly 30 ft. with good maneuverability; darkvision 60 ft.; deflection AC bonus equal to Charisma modifier, minimum +1. Melee touch attack deals 1d6. Telepathy with creatures that have a language within 100 ft.

Manifesting: as a 4th-level psion (telepath), with Intelligence-based DCs. Telepath class levels stack for power points, manifester level, and powers known.

Telekinetic Force: standard action, no attack of opportunity, manifester level 4, Charisma-based DC. Assume Likeness: standard action without provoking to look like any Small, Medium, or Large creature; no ability changes, and Bluff/Disguise still handle suspicion. Hide Mind prevents divination and clairsentience from identifying it as psionic.

Incorporeal: ordinary nonmagical corporeal attacks cannot harm it. Ignore 50% of damage from corporeal sources except force and ghost touch. Pass through solid objects, but not force barriers. Attacks ignore armor, shields, and natural armor, but not force or deflection bonuses. Can move silently without being heard by Listen.

ursoi.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +4; cold resistance 10; scent; +4 racial bonus on Survival and Swim.

Natural attacks: two primary claws for 1d6 + Strength each; secondary bite at −5 for 1d8 + half Strength. Unused claws may be secondary attacks alongside a manufactured weapon.

Improved Grab: a claw hit can begin a grapple without a separate touch attack against a target at least one size smaller. Holding something in the other hand imposes −20 to maintain the hold, but leaves the ursoi ungrappled and able to defend or attack others.

Natural Spell: Wisdom 13 or higher allows verbal spell components despite unusual speech; Wisdom 12 or lower cannot cast spells requiring verbal components.

vanara.text: Low-light vision; climb speed 20 ft. Climb gains +8 racial bonus, uses the higher of Strength or Dexterity, and may always take 10. Balance and Jump gain +4 racial bonuses; Hide and Move Silently gain +2.

vodyanoi.text:
Low-light vision; +2 racial bonus on saves against illusions and on Concentration, Jump, and Spellcraft. Passing within 5 ft. of a water source or permanent spell effect grants a Search check to notice it, without identifying details.

Watercraeft: uses per day equal to Charisma modifier, caster level equal to class level. Choose control water or stone shape affecting water instead of stone; duration becomes concentration + 3 rounds.

At creation choose divination, illusion, conjuration (summoning), or enchantment (charm); spells in that category gain +1 save DC.

Spell-like abilities at caster level 1: speak with animals for aquatic animals only, 1 minute, once daily. Charisma 10 or higher also grants jump, longstrider, and mending once each daily; DC 10 + spell level + Charisma modifier.

warforged-charger.text:
Living construct; space and reach 10 ft.; two slam attacks deal 1d8 each. Adamantine fists overcome applicable damage reduction and object hardness as adamantine weapons.

Adamantine Plating: +8 armor bonus, damage reduction 2/adamantine, maximum Dexterity +1, armor check penalty −5, and 35% arcane spell failure; counts as heavy armor. Does not stack with other armor bonuses. Occupies the armor/robe slot and prevents wearing armor or magic robes; can be enchanted as armor while the charger remains present.

Moderate Fortification: 75% chance to negate a critical hit or sneak attack, rolling ordinary damage instead.

Living Construct: has Constitution and is subject to mind-affecting effects, critical hits, nonlethal damage, stunning, ability damage/drain, death effects, and necromancy. Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, sickening, and energy drain. No eating, breathing, or sleeping; spell preparation still requires rest. Lethal damage does not heal naturally. Healing-subschool spells and supernatural HP/ability healing have half effect; repair magic works normally. Can be raised or resurrected. At 0 HP, disabled without losing HP from exertion; from −1 to −9, inert but stable. Heat/chill metal and repel metal/stone treat the body as metal armor; repel wood also works. Rusting grasp deals 2d6, Reflex DC 14 + caster ability modifier halves; rust-monster touch uses Reflex DC 17. Object-only stone/wood shaping spells do not affect it.

Adamantine Body and Powerful Charge are bonus feats. Plating reduces the listed 30-ft. base speed to 20 ft.

warforged-scout.text:
Living construct.

Composite Plating: +2 armor bonus that does not stack with other armor bonuses; occupies the armor/robe slot and prevents wearing armor or magic robes. Can be enchanted as armor while the scout remains present. Arcane spell failure 5%; abilities that ignore light-armor spell failure also ignore this penalty.

Light Fortification: 25% chance to negate a critical hit or sneak attack, rolling ordinary damage instead.

Living Construct: has Constitution and is subject to mind-affecting effects, critical hits, nonlethal damage, stunning, ability damage/drain, death effects, and necromancy. Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, sickening, and energy drain. No eating, breathing, or sleeping; spell preparation still requires rest. Lethal damage does not heal naturally. Healing-subschool spells and supernatural HP/ability healing have half effect; repair magic works normally. Can be raised or resurrected. At 0 HP, disabled without losing HP from exertion; from −1 to −9, inert but stable. Heat/chill metal and repel metal/stone treat the body as metal armor; repel wood also works. Rusting grasp deals 2d6, Reflex DC 14 + caster ability modifier halves; rust-monster touch uses Reflex DC 17. Object-only stone/wood shaping spells do not affect it.

wemic.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +4; space 10 ft., reach 5 ft.; +8 racial bonus on Jump. Proficient with simple weapons and shields.

Two claws deal 1d6 each. A one-handed weapon can be combined with a secondary claw at −5, adding half Strength to claw damage.

Five racial monstrous humanoid Hit Dice grant base attack +5, base saves +1/+4/+4, two feats, and 8 × (2 + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1) skill points. Racial class skills: Hide, Jump, Listen, Move Silently, Spot, Survival. Only the first racial Hit Die receives maximum hit points; the first class level gains neither automatic maximum hit points nor quadrupled skill points.

wildren.text:
Outsider native to the Beastlands, extraplanar elsewhere; humanoid-only effects do not apply. Darkvision 60 ft.; scent; burrow 10 ft.; two primary claws for 1d4 + Strength each. Dig a one-Medium-creature warren in soil or loose dirt in 1 hour.

Fury: once daily after taking at least 1 damage, enter fury at the start of the next turn. Gain +4 Strength and −2 AC for 1 round; cannot end it early. Stacks with similar effects such as rage.

Stability: +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly standing on the ground.

windrazor.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; see four times human distance in shadowy illumination. Two claws deal 1d4 each; bite deals 1d6.

Fearsome Critical: a critical hit forces every creature within 10 ft. to make a Charisma-based Will save or become shaken; mind-affecting fear effect.

Rend: hitting with both claws adds 2d4 + 1½ Strength bonus damage automatically.

windscythe.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; see four times human distance in shadowy illumination; natural armor +4. Two claws deal 1d6 each; bite deals 1d8.

Augmented Critical: claws threaten on 18–20 and deal ×3 critical damage; effects such as keen edge cannot further increase their threat range.

Fearsome Critical: a critical hit forces every creature within 10 ft. to make a Charisma-based Will save or become shaken; mind-affecting fear effect.

Rend: hitting with both claws adds 2d6 + 1½ Strength bonus damage automatically.

witchknive.text:
Low-light vision; natural armor +1; fire resistance 5; sonic vulnerability. Proficient with simple weapons, light armor, and shields except tower shields.

Psionics (spell-like): caster level 9, Charisma-based DCs. At will: command, message, and silence on self (dismiss as a free action). Greater command once daily.

Sneak Attack: +2d6 damage when flanking or the target is denied Dexterity to AC, subject to rogue sneak-attack rules.

xvart.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; +2 racial bonus on Move Silently.

Speak with Animals: once daily for 1 minute, communicating only with bats and rats, including dire versions.

pureblood.text:
Darkvision 60 ft.; natural armor +1; spell resistance 14 + class levels.

Spell-like abilities once each daily at caster level 4, Charisma-based DCs: animal trance, cause fear, charm person, darkness, and entangle. Detect poison operates at caster level 6.

Alternate Form: polymorph at caster level 19, restricted to Tiny–Large vipers. Changing grants no healing; replace natural weapons with the viper’s. If already poisonous, use whichever poison is more potent.

tainted-one.text:
Alertness as a bonus feat; immune to snake venom, including its own. Spell resistance 12 + 1 per two levels.

Poison Bite: no natural bite attack is granted. First succeed on a grapple check, then a melee attack to inject; a kiss can poison an unresisting target. Fortitude DC 10 + Constitution modifier negates; initial and secondary damage each 1d4 Constitution.

Psionics (spell-like): caster level equals character level. Poison once daily, Fortitude DC 13 + Constitution modifier; polymorph into viper forms only, three times daily.

hellbred-body.text:
Humanoid (hellbred); +2 racial bonus on Intimidate. Evil Exception permits evil-descriptor spells despite alignment/class restrictions and prevents negative levels from evil items, but does not excuse violating a class code. Hellbound: resurrection or stronger magic is required to restore life. Devil’s Favor is a bonus feat without its normal prerequisite.

Body Aspect is permanent: +4 on poison saves; gain a bonus devil-touched feat at 4 Hit Dice and another at 14 Hit Dice. The Spirit aspect’s senses and telepathy are not included.

hellbred-spirit.text:
Humanoid (hellbred); +2 racial bonus on Intimidate. Evil Exception permits evil-descriptor spells despite alignment/class restrictions and prevents negative levels from evil items, but does not excuse violating a class code. Hellbound: resurrection or stronger magic is required to restore life. Devil’s Favor is a bonus feat without its normal prerequisite.

Spirit Aspect is permanent: +2 racial bonus on Sense Motive; darkvision 30 ft., increasing to 60 ft. at 6 Hit Dice and 120 ft. at 9 Hit Dice. At 12 Hit Dice see in all darkness, including deeper darkness; at 15 Hit Dice gain telepathy 100 ft. The Body aspect’s poison bonus and additional feats are not included.

mephling-air.text:
Humanoid native to the Elemental Plane of air; extraplanar on other planes, without an elemental subtype. Spells with the air descriptor gain +1 caster level.

Breath Weapon: a 15-ft. cone deals 1d8 piercing damage; Reflex DC 10 + half Hit Dice + Constitution modifier halves damage. One use daily at first level, plus one per four levels attained. If multiple uses are available, wait 1d4 rounds between uses.

mephling-earth.text:
Humanoid native to the Elemental Plane of earth; extraplanar on other planes, without an elemental subtype. Spells with the earth descriptor gain +1 caster level.

Breath Weapon: a 15-ft. cone deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage; Reflex DC 10 + half Hit Dice + Constitution modifier halves damage. One use daily at first level, plus one per four levels attained. If multiple uses are available, wait 1d4 rounds between uses.

mephling-fire.text:
Humanoid native to the Elemental Plane of fire; extraplanar on other planes, without an elemental subtype. Spells with the fire descriptor gain +1 caster level.

Breath Weapon: a 15-ft. cone deals 1d8 fire damage; Reflex DC 10 + half Hit Dice + Constitution modifier halves damage. One use daily at first level, plus one per four levels attained. If multiple uses are available, wait 1d4 rounds between uses.

mephling-water.text:
Humanoid native to the Elemental Plane of water; extraplanar on other planes, without an elemental subtype. Spells with the water descriptor gain +1 caster level.

Breath Weapon: a 15-ft. cone deals 1d8 acid damage; Reflex DC 10 + half Hit Dice + Constitution modifier halves damage. One use daily at first level, plus one per four levels attained. If multiple uses are available, wait 1d4 rounds between uses.

deepwyrm-half-drow.text:
Dragonblood subtype. Detect magic 3/day and disguise self 1/day, CL equals character level. Bluff +2. Lose the standard Diplomacy bonus and any standard +2 Will bonus against spells/spell-like abilities.

Retained half drow traits: Immune to magical sleep. Enchantment saves +2. Counts as an elf for race-related effects. Darkvision 60 ft.; counts as drow for race-related effects.

forestlord-half-elf.text:
Dragonblood subtype. Hide is always a class skill. Lose enchantment-save bonuses and racial Diplomacy/Gather Information bonuses.

Treewalk (Su): touch and enter a tree as a move action, teleport to another tree within 60 ft., and emerge beside it at the start of your next turn. Uses/day: 1 + one per 5 HD.

Forestlord Pact: attempting to harm a green dragon disables Treewalk for 24 hours and imposes −1 on attacks, saves, caster level and manifester level during that time.

Retained half elf traits: Immune to magical sleep. Counts as an elf for race-related effects.
